sql_templates.description: Fetch the latest stage snapshots and join with portfolio holdings for decision analysis.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (
    SELECT * FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT 
    holdings.symbol, 
    holdings.qty, 
    snapshots.sector, 
    snapshots.trading_signal, 
    snapshots.stage, 
    snapshots.relative_strength
FROM 
    portfolio.holdings AS holdings
JOIN 
    latest_snapshots AS snapshots ON holdings.symbol = snapshots.symbol
WHERE 
    snapshots.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
LIMIT 100;

sql_templates.description: Fetch FII/DII flows, regime, and breadth details for the last 3 months.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_flows AS (
    SELECT trade_date, fii_net_today, dii_net_today, flow_signal
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
), latest_regime AS (
    SELECT trade_date, regime, confidence
    FROM signals.regime_history
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
), latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT trade_date, adv_signal, market_sentiment
    FROM breadth.market_daily
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
), latest_index AS (
    SELECT trade_date, close, change_pct
    FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
    AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
)
SELECT 
    f.trade_date, 
    f.fii_net_today, 
    f.dii_net_today, 
    f.flow_signal, 
    r.regime, 
    r.confidence, 
    b.adv_signal, 
    b.market_sentiment, 
    i.close AS index_close,
    i.change_pct AS index_change_pct
FROM latest_flows f
JOIN latest_regime r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN latest_breadth b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN latest_index i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
ORDER BY f.trade_date DESC;

synthesis_guidance: Integrate FII/DII flow analysis, regime trends, breadth diagnostics, and index movements to frame risk contexts, mindful of portfolio adjustments.
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 0442
tool_plan_template: Examine FII/DII trends alongside market regime and breadth to provide portfolio-aware insights for the last 3 months.
